label: NUP98::HOXA9

sections.text: NUP98 encodes a nuclear pore protein with an amino-terminal region involved in transport and transcriptional regulation.
HOXA9 encodes a homeobox transcription factor involved in hematopoietic progenitor programs.

The fusion retains the amino-terminal FG-repeat region of NUP98 and creates an abnormal transcriptional regulator associated with sustained HOX-gene expression. The HOXA9 homeodomain supplies DNA binding to the NUP98 activation region.
